lines:
You can choose from three different text-scrolling speeds
to control how quickly messages appear.

You can choose whether you wish to see move
animations during battles or not.

You can choose whether to be asked about switching
Pokémon when an opposing Pokémon faints.

You can select a different wallpaper to be used on the
lower screen during battles.

You can disable the L and R Buttons, or set the L Button
to function as the A Button. This also disables the R Button.

You can choose whether or not you must save before
PSS battles and other communication features.
Would you like to make these changes?
